dedupe_keys.name: a simulation study of mixed trucks and robots for last mile delivery

description: The 2025 documented delivery model divides Bari into hub-served zones and maximises daily deliveries using trucks for trunk transport and robots for narrow streets or sidewalks. SUMO experiments represent road-traffic effects and compare the proposed delivery system with conventional delivery. A separate 2023 Vissim-based paper has a related hub-zone formulation and different authorship. Their exact model and experiment equivalence is unresolved, so both source-defined implementations retain distinct identities and no sample totals are combined. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: A Simulation Study of Mixed Trucks and Robots for Last Mile Delivery
